# LLM entry point

Primary instructions: AGENTS.md
Research design: PROJECT_PLAN.md
Live checklist: reports/PREP_STATUS.md
Run history: reports/CHANGELOG_RUNS.md
Known pitfalls: reports/MISTAKES.md
Course corpus: llm_corpus/INDEX.md

Core rule: all models receive identical prompts. Feature inference is paired by prompt and family. Ordinary classification groups by prompt_id; the robustness analysis withholds a complete task_type.
Core scope: 15 confirmatory features, paired comparisons, prompt-blocked logistic regression, leave-one-task-type-out, length sensitivity, and optional PCA.
Out of scope: mixed-effects models, cross-family classifier transfer, required clustering, and universal claims about model generations.
